prompt: Which country has hosted the most Olympic Games—both Summer and Winter—in the past 20 years?
answer:
Using a rolling 20-year period up to October 27, 2026, **China** has hosted the most Olympic Games—**two**:

- **2008 Summer Olympics** — Beijing  
- **2022 Winter Olympics** — Beijing  

If “the past 20 years” is taken to include all Games from **2006 through 2026**, then **Italy also hosted two**—Turin 2006 and Milan–Cortina 2026—so China and Italy would be tied.
